text: 老妇人凑近你，凝视着你的双眼。“你的躯壳适合容纳我的本质。孩子们，准备好这具躯壳。”
灰色小战士把你的手腕和脚踝绑在地上的木桩上。其中一人逼你喝下一只陶杯里的酒液。你顿时感到飘飘然，仿佛陷入迷醉，对周围那些举着粗制火把、喋喋不休并吟唱的人毫不在意。
老妇人费力地在你头后跪下，把如爪的手指按在你的太阳穴上，大声祈祷：“伊亚，奈亚拉托提普！伊亚，雷巴托斯！伊亚，伊塔库亚！N’ehye n’grkudlu’lh！”
突然间，你无忧无虑的心情烟消云散。女祭司的心灵像污秽的利爪，在你的头骨里攀爬，企图侵入并取代你。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 255
text: The crone leans close, gazing deep into your eyes. “You are a suitable shell for my essence. Prepare her, my children.”

The little gray warriors bind your wrists and ankles to stakes in the earth. One of them forces you to drink from a clay beaker. The liquor makes you feel light, entranced. You are unconcerned about the people around you, holding crude tapers, chattering, and chanting.
Grunting with the effort, the old woman kneels behind your head. She places her claw-like fingers on your temples and prays loudly. “Iä Nyarlathotep! Iä Rebathoth! Iä Ithaqua! N’ehye n’grkudlu’lh!”
Suddenly your carefree mood evaporates. The priestess’s psyche feels like a foul, clawing thing inside your skull. It intends to infiltrate and replace you.
